summary: ASE Technology Holding Co., Ltd. filed a Form 6-K containing its Q1 2026 earnings release. The filing presents consolidated financial results with net revenues of NT$173,662 million for Q1 2026, down 2% sequentially but up 17% year-over-year. Net income attributable to shareholders was NT$14,148 million (diluted EPS NT$3.08), down 4% QoQ but up 87% YoY. This is a routine earnings announcement under Rule 13a-16, not a special-situation event. There is no transaction, activist, or strategic action described; the filing is purely operational and financial in nature. No deal terms or special-situation elements are present.
